alive.last_commit_message:
Preview the head and tail of large command output (#1260)

* Tell the chat model that an output preview can be partial

The chat tool instructions said output_preview only ever held complete,
small command output. Command receipts now also carry a partial head and
tail for larger output, so the instructions say to use the preview
directly and read its omitted lines with tool_output.read only when
needed.

* Preview the head and tail of large command output

A command receipt inlined output only when every stream fit 4 KiB in
total; anything larger gave the model artifact references alone. On live
Core over three days 49,242 command results had no preview and
tool_output.read then ran 23,083 times, each an extra round trip over
the whole context.

command_output_preview keeps the complete small preview and otherwise
gives each stream its redacted head and tail around an omission marker,
marked partial with total_lines, total_bytes and the omitted line range
for tool_output.read. The preview shrinks until the whole receipt fits
MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES. Lines are redacted whole (an over-long line is
redacted before it is cut), and an unmatched private-key marker stops
the head or tail before key material. A complete preview keeps its old
receipt shape; partial receipts keep tool_output.search/read in
next_actions, and failure context keeps a partial preview's tail.

tool_output.read now defaults to, and allows, 400 lines per page; the
8 KiB page bound still applies.
